slices.title: Implement reviveFailedTask in PlannedWorkRecoveryService
slices.jtbd: When implementing the missing API logic for this epic, I want to add the reviveFailedTask mechanism, so that closed unmerged PR failures can be successfully revived
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a closed unmerged pull request failure, When PlannedWorkRecoveryService is invoked, Then the task is successfully revived via the new reviveFailedTask mechanism.
Given the requirement to measure success and ensure quality, When unit and E2E tests are executed alongside GQM tracking, Then they thoroughly verify the implementation and accurately track the error rate of revived tasks.
